newsitem.title: UK: Euroclear accepts Philippine peso for settlement.
newsitem.headline: Euroclear accepts Philippine peso for settlement.

text.p: The Philippine peso has been accepted as a settlement currency in the Euroclear system, the international securities clearing firm said in a statement on Friday.
The peso has been accepted for money transfer and internal settlement of transactions between Euroclear participants.

"This move to accept the Philippine peso is in line with the ongoing Euroclear commitment to expand our network to emerging markets, particularly Asia," Camille Lavirotte, an associate in Euroclear's market services division, said in the statement.
Euroclear now clears transactions in 37 currencies, it said. --Denise Manning, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7658
